card.name: Digits and lipase just before enzyme units
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number, or the word lipase, when the next word is likely an enzyme unit such as U, U/L or Klein units. It appears in enzyme level and enzyme dosing text.

modes.label: Number before enzyme unit
modes.description: A digit inside an enzyme or lab value, right before a unit such as U or Klein units.

modes.label: Lipase before units
modes.description: The word lipase in pancreatic enzyme dosing, just before units/kg/meal.
modes.example: Patients receiving dosages higher than 6,000 lip<<ase>> units/kg/meal should be frequently monitored
